name: Curried Chickpeas with Honey Glazed Carrots & Pickled Radish
steps: Quick-pickle the radishes: slice thinly and toss with vinegar and a pinch of salt. Set aside.
Peel and cut carrots into batons. Dice the red onion.
Heat oil in a pan over medium heat. Cook onion 3 min, add curry powder and stir 1 min.
Add chickpeas and coconut milk, simmer 8 min.
Meanwhile, toss carrots with honey and a drizzle of oil. Cook in a hot pan for 10–12 min, turning, until caramelised.
Serve chickpea curry topped with honey carrots, pickled radish and fresh coriander.
